from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0040.png").convert("RGB"))

# Let find the 4th leg of the chair:
# Look in u in [240, 275], v from 420 down to 500
# In obs_0040, leg 4 is the front-right leg:
for u in range(240, 280):
    col = img[:, u, :]
    t = np.where((col[:, 0] > 90) & (col[:, 0] < 180) & (col[:, 1] > 40) & (col[:, 1] < 110) & (col[:, 2] < 60))[0]
    # filter t for leg bottom (below seat, say v > 420)
    leg_pix = t[t > 420]
    if len(leg_pix) > 0:
        print(f"u={u}: max_v={leg_pix.max()}")

# Also let check behind the chair: the grey cube / table / ottoman!
# In obs_0040, between u=180 and u=270, there is a grey object behind the chair!
# Let inspect its color and coordinates:
grey_mask = (abs(img[:, :, 0].astype(int) - img[:, :, 1].astype(int)) < 15) & \
            (abs(img[:, :, 1].astype(int) - img[:, :, 2].astype(int)) < 15) & \
            (img[:, :, 0] > 80) & (img[:, :, 0] < 160)
# Look at v around 300..400
for u in range(180, 270, 10):
    rows = np.where(grey_mask[:, u])[0]
    if len(rows) > 0:
        print(f"Grey object u={u}: v_range=[{rows.min()}, {rows.max()}], color={img[rows.mean().astype(int), u]}")
'
